comparison.objective: Commission and lock a shock absorber vs replace an air-conditioner mesh filter behind a hinged cover.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed hex-bit alignment, torque control, fine collar rotation, reacquisition, and iterative cycling vs opening a cover, unhooking a thin filter, fitting another behind lugs/lip, and closing the cover.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming, force-bounded stops with setting retention vs dusty filter removed, clean filter seated within 2 mm/3°/10 mm tolerances, cover within 3°, held 1 s.
comparison.reason: Filter extraction and constrained panel fitting do not test mechanical tuning, captive locking, or dynamic response.
